title: ContactPointPhone - Data API
description: Represents a contact’s phone number, which is associated with an individual or person account. This object is available in API version 48.0 and later.

ActiveFromDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ActiveFromDate.description: The date when the contact’s phone number became active.

ActiveToDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ActiveToDate.description: The date when the contact’s phone number is no longer active.

AreaCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AreaCode.description: The area code of the phone number’s location for the contact.

BestTimeToContactEndTime.description: The latest time to contact the individual.

BestTimeToContactStartTime.description: The earliest time to contact the individual.

BestTimeToContactTimezone.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
BestTimeToContactTimezone.description: The timezone applied to the best time to contact the individual.

ExtensionNumber.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExtensionNumber.description: The phone number extension for the contact.

FormattedInternationalPhoneNumber.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
FormattedInternationalPhoneNumber.description: The internationally recognized format for the contact’s phone number.

FormattedNationalPhoneNumber.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
FormattedNationalPhoneNumber.description: The nationally recognized format for the contact’s phone number.

IsBusinessPhone.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsBusinessPhone.description: Indicates whether a contact’s phone number is a business number (true) or not (false).

IsFaxCapable.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsFaxCapable.description: Indicates whether a contact’s phone number is a fax number (true) or not (false).

IsPersonalPhone.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsPersonalPhone.description: Indicates whether a contact’s phone number is a personal number (true) or not (false).

IsPrimary.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsPrimary.description: Indicates whether a contact’s phone number is their primary number (true) or not (false).

IsSmsCapable.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsSmsCapable.description: Indicates whether a contact’s phone number can receive text messages (true) or not (false).

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

Name.description: The name of the contact point phone record.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the account’s owner associated with this contact. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

ParentId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ParentId.description: The ID of the contact’s parent. Only an individual or account can be a contact’s parent. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

PhoneType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
PhoneType.description: The type of phone number for the contact. Possible values are: Home Mobile

PreferenceRank.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PreferenceRank.description: Specify how this phone numbers ranks in terms of preference among the contact’s other phone numbers.

TelephoneNumber.description: The phone number for the contact.

UsageType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
UsageType.description: Specify the usage type of this number. For instance, whether it’s a work phone or a home phone. Possible values are: Home Temp Work

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **ContactPointConsentChangeEvent**: Change events are available for the object.
- **ContactPointPhoneHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **ContactPointPhoneOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **ContactPointPhoneShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
